subject: PLG marketplace: partner-issued credit handoff / self-serve onboarding
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@skylinecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: partners@marketplace.cloudforge.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Partner credits: self-serve pass-through for PLG signups

Hi Jordan —

Quick ask from our integrations team: Skyline is rolling a co-branded marketplace listing on CloudForge that will route PLG signups to Redwood. We want to make the initial trial flow frictionless by issuing partner-sponsored credits that the customer can redeem in self-serve during signup (no back-and-forth).

Key asks:
- Can Redwood accept a partner-issued credit SKU that maps to an internal promo code?
- We need a simple handoff: Skyline uploads a CSV of redemption IDs to your billing system, or CloudForge will pass through a marketplace voucher token.
- Approval from finance/legal on the attached pass-through terms (attached: partner-pass-through-terms-v1.pdf) and the credit request form (attached).

Estimate: ~1,200 trial credits/month initially (small $ cap), tiered top-ups if conversion looks strong. We expect the first batch to land 11/24.

Could you confirm whether Redwood supports a self-serve redemption flow for partner-issued credits and what information you need from Skyline? Happy to jump on a 30-min call if helpful.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Head of Partnerships | Skyline Cloud
elena@skylinecloud.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: skyline_credit_request_form.pdf, partner-pass-through-terms-v1.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@skylinecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Partner credits: self-serve pass-through for PLG signups

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding a partner request from Skyline. They want to issue partner-sponsored credits that the end-user redeems during signup (via CloudForge marketplace token or CSV ingestion).

Quick context: Skyline is a new marketplace partner; small initial batch (~1.2k credits/month). They want a self-serve flow rather than manual issuance per user. Attached their request form and our current draft of terms.

Questions for ops/finance/legal before I commit to timelines:
- Is there an existing marketplace voucher ingestion API or do we need to build a little passthrough endpoint?
- What guardrails do we require for partner-issued credits (expiry, per-account cap, refund/chargeback handling)?
- Can we automate redemption mapping so Skyline controls issuance without manual ops intervention?

Can you triage and advise on next steps? If feasible this week, they want the first batch ready by 11/24.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise GTM | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0172
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Morales <elena@skylinecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partner credits: self-serve pass-through for PLG signups

Jordan —

Thanks for the forward. Quick answers and requests inline.

On Tue, Nov 17, 2026 at 10:03 AM Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Vivek — forwarding a partner request from Skyline. They want to issue partner-sponsored credits that the end-user redeems during signup (via CloudForge marketplace token or CSV ingestion).

We do have a marketplace voucher ingestion endpoint for a small set of partners but it requires a one-time mapping to a Redwood promo SKU and a signed partner addendum (billing + liability language). Ops can ingest CSV files for emergency/backfill, but we prefer tokens for scale.

Need from Skyline before legal/finance will clear:
- Confirm per-account credit cap (suggested: $150 per account for trial).
- Confirm credit expiration window (suggested: 90 days).
- Provide expected redemption format (token vs CSV). If token, provide sample token payload.

I reviewed the attached terms. Legal wants a single sentence added about chargebacks and a clause tying Skyline to customer eligibility checks. I've attached a redline (see attached: sku_mapping.csv — note: this is just a mapping sample; separate redline doc to follow).

If Skyline confirms the three items above by EOD 11/19, finance will approve a pilot allocation of 1,200 credits for Nov and a monthly review cadence. Ops can schedule ingestion on 11/24 if token flow is used.

Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@skylinecloud.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Partner credits: self-serve pass-through for PLG signups

All — finalizing on my side.

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Marissa. Finance signs off on a conditional pilot: 1,200 credits for Nov (total $6,000 not to exceed) with the following conditions that must be satisfied before we flip the switch:
- Signed partner addendum (DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embeddedSigning/abc123)
- Per-account cap set to $150 and 90-day expiry
- Token-based redemption preferred; CSV ingestion allowed only for CSV backfills (ops runbook required)

Elena — please confirm you can accept the per-account cap and expiry and whether CloudForge will provide token payload samples by EOD 11/19. Once we have the signed addendum and sample token, Ops will create promo SKU REDWOOD-PARTNER-SKY-1126 and schedule a token ingestion window on 11/24 09:00 PT.

Attaching the agreed artifacts for ops: skyline_credit_request_form.pdf, sku_mapping.csv.

Vivek Kulkarni
